info.title: Recoup API - Social
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: Retrieve all social media posts from an artist across all platforms. This endpoint aggregates posts from all connected social media profiles for the specified artist. Supports pagination for large post collections.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the artist account to fetch posts for

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve (default: 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of records per page (default: 20, max: 100)

400.description: Bad request - invalid or missing `id` path parameter format

403.description: Forbidden - caller does not have access to this artist

get.description: Retrieve comments associated with an artist or a specific post, with support for pagination. This endpoint returns raw comment data including the comment text, associated post, and commenter's social profile reference.

parameters.name: artist_account_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the artist account to fetch comments for

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Filter comments by specific post

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of comments per page (default: 10)

get.description: Search for artists, albums, tracks, and playlists using the Spotify API. This endpoint is a proxy to the official Spotify Search API.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query keywords and optional field filters

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of item types to search across: album, artist, playlist, track, show, episode, audiobook

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or 'from_token'

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, min: 1, max: 50)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The index of the first result to return (default: 0, max: 10000)

get.description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single artist identified by their unique Spotify ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Spotify ID of the artist

get.description: Get Spotify catalog information about an artist's albums.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Spotify ID of the artist

parameters.name: include_groups
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of keywords to filter the response. Valid values are: album, single, appears_on, compilation

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. If specified, only content available in that market will be returned

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return (default: 20, min: 1, max: 50)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The index of the first item to return (default: 0)

get.description: Get an artist's top tracks by country.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Spotify ID of the artist

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. If provided, only tracks available in that market are returned

get.description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single album.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Spotify ID of the album

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. If provided, only content available in that market is returned

get.description: Fetch Instagram comments for multiple post URLs using Apify's Instagram Comment Scraper. The actual comment data will be available in the Apify dataset after the run completes.

parameters.name: postUrls
parameters.description: Array of Instagram post URLs to fetch comments for

parameters.name: resultsLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of comments to fetch (default: 10000)

parameters.name: isNewestComments
parameters.description: Whether to fetch newest comments first. Set to true for newest first, false for oldest first, or omit for platform default sorting

get.description: Fetch Instagram profile information for multiple handles using Apify's Instagram Profile Scraper. The actual profile data will be available in the Apify dataset after the run completes.

parameters.name: handles
parameters.description: Array of Instagram handles to fetch profiles for

get.description: Check the status and retrieve results from Apify scraper runs. This endpoint uses the Apify API Client to fetch the current status of a scraper run and its results if available. Use the runId returned from endpoints like Instagram Comments, Instagram Profiles, Social Scrape, or Artist Socials Scrape to poll for results.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: The ID of the Apify run to check status for. This is returned when starting a scrape via Instagram Comments, Instagram Profiles, Social Scrape, or Artist Socials Scrape endpoints.

200.description: Scraper run status retrieved successfully. Returns status info for in-progress runs, or status info plus data for completed runs.

400.description: Bad request - missing required runId parameter

500.description: Server error - failed to fetch run status from Apify

post.description: Trigger a social profile scraping job for a given social profile. Use the [Get Artist Socials](/api-reference/artists/socials) endpoint first to retrieve the social profile id values. The response returns Apify run metadata for polling status and retrieving results via the [Apify Scraper Results API](/api-reference/apify/scraper).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the social profile to scrape. Obtain this from the [Get Artist Socials](/api-reference/artists/socials) API.

get.description: List available connectors and their connection status. Returns all supported third-party integrations (e.g., Google Sheets, TikTok) along with whether they are currently connected.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional account ID to get connectors for a different account (e.g., an artist, workspace, or organization). The authenticated account must have access to the specified account. Omit to get your own account's connectors.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - no access to the specified account

delete.description: Disconnect a connected account from a third-party service. This revokes the OAuth connection and removes stored credentials.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - no access to the specified account or connection

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key
